title: Group Chat and Recipe
author: Isandro Blackwood
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
